WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref,
    st.riskeval,
    COUNT(*) as num_scans,
    AVG(s.pressratio) as avg_compression
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval
)
SELECT
  zoneref,
  riskeval,
  avg_compression,
  num_scans,
  num_scans * 1.0 / SUM(num_scans) OVER () as share
FROM matched_scans
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
